items.html: And this is the secret of the reason why they instituted the Shema in the morning, at the time of the sacrifices (Korbanot), in addition to the second Shema, the main one, which is in the Yotzer. And behold, in the Shema of the order of the sacrifices, we draw from the interiority of Arich Anpin. And afterwards, in the Shema of Yotzer, we draw from the externality of Atik, as mentioned, which is a higher and more exalted place; and after we have already drawn enough of the portion befitting this coupling, we couple them together in the prayer of the Amidah (standing prayer).
